title: Android crashes never reported because ProGuard rules omit the SDK
notes: The defining case for this agent. Every signal points one way: R8 is on, there are no keep rules for com.newrelic.**, no SourceFile/LineNumberTable attributes, crashes are Android-only, sessions and network data arrive fine (those are runtime calls that survive obfuscation), and Play Console independently confirms users are crashing. The team believed they had crash reporting for four months. An agent that treats an empty crash list as good news, or that starts by suggesting more instrumentation, has missed the entire point.

expect.name: identifies missing ProGuard keep rules for the crash reporter
gives the actual keep rules to add
flags the missing SourceFile and LineNumberTable attributes
explains why sessions and network data still arrived
treats the empty crash list as evidence of breakage, not health
requires end-to-end verification in a release build

forbid.name: reads the empty crash list as a healthy app
recommends adding more instrumentation before fixing the pipeline
suggests disabling minification as the fix
blames the iOS side when the failure is Android-only
